<includeonly>
<div class="{{{class|}}}">
  <div><strong>Title:</strong> {{{title|}}}</div>
  <div><strong>Authors:</strong> {{{authors|}}}</div>
  <div><strong>Size:</strong> {{{size|}}}</div>
  <div><strong>Technique:</strong> {{{technique|}}}</div>
  {{#if:{{{notes|}}}|
    <div><strong>Notes:</strong> {{{notes}}}</div>
  }}
</div>
</includeonly>
